summary: A family-wide shortcut answers every normal question: choose the third-smallest mass. Confirmed on 28 independent samples, all five delivered batch items, and ten reproduced stored generated questions. Source replay also fails. Package files remained unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Construct and solve a variable-volume mixture model, determine overflow time, and evaluate the solute mass there.
reasoning_steps: Calculate volume growth and overflow time.
Solve the linear ODE using an integrating factor and initial condition.
Evaluate at overflow, round, and select the numerical mass.
invariants: Well-mixed tank with constant positive inflow, outflow, and feed concentration.
Capacity exceeds initial volume; inflow exceeds outflow.
Consistent mass balance, units, and initial condition.
Normal questions use one five-choice numerical radio field.
permitted_variations: Vary physical quantities and capacity while updating every dependent expression.
Vary context without changing the mathematical response.
Vary distractors, correct-choice position, and correct numerical rank; these assignments are incidental.

source_replay.details: Four supplied source profiles raise Unknown template. Raw q-336451 replay emits two fields versus one in the supplied source. Missing source evidence is documented separately.

math.details: Independent prompt-derived calculations agree for 38 generated records, including exact ODE and initial-condition residuals and rounded masses.

variety.details: Parameter and context variation preserve a universally correct median-choice action. All five actual batch records survive delivery filtering and retain it.

scope.details: Tested easy variants preserve the overflow task, quadratic integrating factor, and five-choice response workload.

grading.details: Native learner grader produced 20 expected acceptances and 69 expected rejections, with zero unresolved cases.

rendering.details: Actual UI rendered 17 records without reported errors. Screenshots inspected for the complete batch, every template, and controlled pairs.

packaging.details: Exact dependency versions, deterministic replay, and relocated CLI execution pass. Original package hashes are unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Controlled dependencies update correctly, but bank construction forces numerical rank 3. Conditional template probes and delivered-batch measurements confirm the bypass. Ten stored generated questions are demonstrated affected.

findings.description: Normal bank construction always puts two distractors below and two above the correct mass. Selecting the third-smallest choice bypasses mixture modeling and integration. Rejection, shuffling, deduplication, and learner selection preserve this property.
